summary: Sabesp and EMAE filed a joint material fact updating the timetable for Sabesp's incorporation of all EMAE shares it does not already own, a stock-for-stock merger under Brazilian law (equivalent to a US merger/squeeze-out). EMAE shareholders receive Sabesp common shares; no price per share, premium, or expected close dates are stated in the excerpt. Shareholders approved at meetings on July 30 and September 16, 2026. A statutory withdrawal right ran September 18 to October 19, 2026, with bookkeeping migrating from BTG to Itau. Watch appraisal/withdrawal demand, remaining regulatory steps, and any revised timetable slippage as risk-arb levers.
